summary: Hybrid jobs let Cloud DLP inspect external data sources.
extended_definition: Hybrid jobs let Cloud DLP inspect external data sources.

supporting_pages.title: "Hybrid jobs and job triggers \_|\_ Sensitive Data Protection \_|\_ Google\
evidence_snippets: Many organizations store and process sensitive data using some combination of the following: Other cloud providers On-premises servers or other data repositories Non-native storage systems, such as systems running inside a virtual machine Web and mobile apps Google Cloud-based solutions Using hybrid jobs, Sensitive Data Protection can inspect data sent to it from any of these sources.
What's next To learn how to use hybrid jobs and job triggers to receive data for inspection, see Sending external data to Sensitive Data Protection using hybrid jobs .
To learn how to implement hybrid jobs and job triggers, see Inspecting external data using hybrid jobs .

supporting_pages.title: Sensitive Data Protection overview \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Learn how to inspect data from external sources using hybrid jobs .
Inspection through a job You can configure inspection and hybrid jobs through the Google Cloud console or through the Cloud Data Loss Prevention API.
Hybrid jobs A hybrid job lets you scan payloads of data sent from any source, and then store the inspection findings in Google Cloud.
